messages:
Alex (Partnerships): Quick vendor sync — can folks give a short status for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi re: marketplace readiness + SI integration? Any embargo windows we need to lock for joint announce next month? cc @Maya @Jonah @Rachel @Samir
Maya (Eng-Platform): Gaudi lab image + kernel validated on our staging cluster. CI flaky on 2 tests (mem pressure); engineering PR in flight. ETA for green is ~5 business days. We have a working image tag: ghcr.io/redwood/gaudi:staging-20240321
Jonah (Product): Thanks. Product asks we not overlap NV partner press week — propose announce window week-of 1712000000. Need firm vendor gating (firmware, driver, marketplace SKU).
Rachel (Field/Sales): Field needs 2 weeks pre-announce enablement + partner one-pager and sales deck. Also need SKU mapping for Dedicated vs Hosted. If there's an embargo, sales should get the brief ASAP. :loudspeaker:
Samir (SI Liaison): For SI dry-run: I need VPC test creds and a small test dataset. Can we run the integration smoke on 1709200000? I'll prep the runbook and checklist. Also we should confirm whether quantized weights for MI300 are allowed in our marketplace images.
Maya (Eng-Platform): MI300 driver/ROCm side — upstream ROCR updates landed but vendor microcode still pending. We have a compatibility note: ROCm>=5.6 + kernel >=5.19. ETA from infra team: firmware signoff by 3/28.
Alex (Partnerships): Noted. Can someone paste a super short gating matrix here (one line per vendor) so partners can sign off quickly?
Jonah (Product): Sure — quick draft:```
H100: driver 2.1.x, fw 2024-03-30, marketplace image tag: redwood/h100:ga-v2, embargo window: 2-week preannounce
H200/B200: driver 2.0.x, fw rolling, recommended quantization: int8, marketplace tag: redwood/h200-b200:preview
MI300: ROCm 6.x required, fw pending (3/28), marketplace tag: redwood/mi300:beta
Gaudi: validated image ghcr.io/redwood/gaudi:staging-20240321, triton plugin 0.9, embargo: flexible
```
Rachel (Field/Sales): That helps. Can we add 'docs ready' and 'sales deck' columns? If not here, please drop links to both when ready.
Samir (SI Liaison): Adding to my checklist: VPC creds, image pull tests, end-to-end latency run, KV cache validation. I'll open a short PR with the runbook by EOD.
Maya (Eng-Platform): I'll run the image pull + inference smoke on Gaudi and H100 tonight and post logs. If we hit the mem pressure again, we'll flip a kernel param (vm.max_map_count) and re-run.
partner-bot: Meeting scheduled: Vendor Roadmap Sync — Thu 09:00 PT, invite sent to participants. Agenda: gating matrix finalization, SI dry-run plan, marketplace SKU freeze. Link: https://calendar.redwood/meet/XYZ
Alex (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Maya — post CI logs + confirm GAUDI pass by 3/25. 2) Samir — PR runbook + schedule SI dry-run on 1709200000. 3) Jonah — finalize embargo window proposal and share with vendor comms. 4) Rachel — prepare sales deck stub and partner one-pager draft. I'll consolidate and send to partners after the Thu sync. :white_check_mark:
